about.heroDesc: Newra News is an intelligent news portal that aggregates the world's top stories and automatically generates a daily article summarizing the most relevant events — all with the help of artificial intelligence.
about.whatIsDesc: News consumers face information overload. Dozens of portals, hundreds of headlines and little time to take it all in. Newra News solves this by offering two experiences: a news feed updated daily for those who want to browse, and a daily summary article for those who want to understand the big picture in a few minutes.

steps.collectionDesc: Multiple sources are checked daily to bring together the most relevant stories of the day.
steps.aiDesc: Artificial intelligence analyzes, cross-references and synthesizes the collected information into a coherent article.
steps.dailyDesc: A summary article is published automatically, letting you understand the day in a few minutes.

about.stackDesc: Built with modern technologies focused on performance, type safety and developer experience.
about.openSourceDesc: The Newra News source code is available on GitHub.

newsletter.benefitBriefDesc: Not a roundup of headlines. A text that connects what happened, with the sources it consulted listed at the end.
newsletter.benefitRhythmDesc: Sent in the morning, every day. No notifications, no email sequence, no upsell.
newsletter.benefitSourcesDesc: Every briefing shows where each piece of information came from. Nothing is asserted without an origin.
newsletter.ctaDescription: Get the Newra Daily by email: the day’s article, written from the main stories, in a single read.
newsletter.ctaHeadline: The world does not fit in your feed. The right summary fits in your morning.
newsletter.ctaPrivacy: One email a day. Unsubscribe whenever you want, in one click.
newsletter.error: Couldn't subscribe right now. Please try again.
newsletter.faqAiA: Yes, and every article says so. Source curation is automatic and the text is generated by a language model from them.
newsletter.faqAiQ: Is the text written by AI?
newsletter.faqCancelA: Every email carries an unsubscribe link that works in one click, with no login and no questions.
newsletter.faqDataA: We store the address only, and use it only to send the briefing. It is never shared or sold.
newsletter.faqDataQ: What do you do with my email?
newsletter.faqFrequencyA: Once a day, in the morning. That is all — there is no second send and no welcome series.
newsletter.footerDesc: Get the article of the day in your inbox, straight from the top stories.
newsletter.invalidDesc: We couldn't cancel the subscription with this link. Check the email you received or try again.
newsletter.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
newsletter.landingLede: Every day the AI reads the main stories from Brazil and the world and writes one article, with its sources in plain sight. You read once and know what happened.
newsletter.landingTitle: The Newra Daily in your inbox
newsletter.success: You'll receive the daily article in your inbox!
newsletter.unsubscribedDesc: You won't receive the daily article anymore. If you change your mind, simply subscribe again from the footer of the site.
